subject: Medicore — IR simulation request and runbook / evidence handover
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@medicore-health.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@medicore-health.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IR simulation + evidence list for upcoming audit

Hi Chloe,

Hope you’re doing well. Medicore is scheduling a tabletop incident simulation in mid-October as part of our Q4 compliance review and we’d like Redwood to participate. To prepare, we need the following from you by Oct 1: a copy of your incident response runbook (high-level), a redacted forensic log bundle from a previous tabletop (if available), and a short list of the artifacts you can share during a live walkthrough (SOC 2 controls mapping, SIEM extracts, timeline examples).

Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the walkthrough and whether you can provide a redacted log bundle that removes any customer-identifying data? Also please confirm any transport preferences (secure SFTP, pre-signed URLs).

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation.

Anita Rao
Head of Security Operations
Medicore Health
anita.rao@medicore-health.com
+1 (415) 555-0184

[Attachment: Medicore_Tabletop_Scope.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: IR simulation + evidence list for upcoming audit

Hi Anita — thanks for the note and the scope doc. We can run a 60‑90 minute live walkthrough and will provide a redacted forensic bundle and the runbook extract ahead of time.

Proposed owners for the session: Marissa (sec ops) will lead the IRP walkthrough and tabletop facilitation; Diego (infra) will cover log extraction/retention; Neha will field SOC 2 control mappings; Jonas will speak to the runtime/serving telemetry; Laura will cover compliance evidence handling and redaction.

We’ll deliver by Oct 1:
- Redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf — high-level runbook extract (attachment)
- medicore_redacted_forensics_bundle.zip — redacted log bundle (will be staged on our secure SFTP; see delivery note below)
- runbook-change-log.md — short changelog and contact points

Transport: we prefer secure SFTP for full forensic bundles; for small artifacts we can provide time-limited pre-signed URLs. We will not transmit raw customer PII in any artifact.

Please let us know three time windows in mid-October that work for your team and whether you want a tabletop that includes a simulated data-exfiltration scenario or a service-degradation scenario.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Customer Success — Security Programs
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf (PDF, 340KB)]

Folks — follow-up from Chloe. Quick notes on what I’ll provide and open items: 

Artifacts we can share by Oct 1 (redacted where needed):
- Redacted SIEM export (last 30 days) — will strip any customer identifiers and IPs that map to third-party tenants.
- Auth logs (service-level) — aggregated timelines only.
- Sample forensic event timeline from tabletop 2025-11 (already sanitized) — attached as medicore_redacted_forensics_bundle.zip (stub).
- Incident response runbook extract — attached as Redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf.
- Control references (SOC 2 mappings) — Neha to confirm mapping doc.

Open items for Diego: provide SFTP path and temporary credentials rotation process.
Open for Compliance: Laura to confirm acceptable redaction standard for Medicore (tokenization vs full removal).

I’ll prepare a one-page cheat sheet for the tabletop facilitator with the standard scripts and expected MOPs.

—Marissa

Thanks Chloe/Marissa — that all sounds good. A few clarifications before we finalize: 

1) For the redacted forensic bundle — we’ll need a manifest that lists which fields were removed (e.g., tenant IDs, IPs). Can you produce a manifest CSV?
2) For SOC 2 control mapping — we’ll want to see the specific control references (mapping of runbook steps to CC6/CC7 or equivalent).
3) Time windows: Oct 12–14 (PST) are preferred.

If you can confirm the manifest and control mapping by Oct 1 we’ll lock in Oct 13 for a 90-minute tabletop with two Medicore observers and one auditor present.

Regards,
Anita

Secure share & access:
SFTP host: files.redwood-inference.com
Path: /medicore/secure/
Temporary username: medicore_review_2026
Note: credentials and MFA instructions will be sent via Out-of-band secure message (we do not send SFTP creds in email).
